title: terraform-proxmox deployment.json (desired-state INPUT)
description: Contract for the private desired-state input fetched from the on-prem S3-compatible object store at plan/apply. Its job is to REJECT an empty or structurally-broken input before any plan runs, so a missing/blank file can never produce a destroy-all plan. additionalProperties stays true so per-environment extras and `_*comment` keys never false-fail; only the load-bearing shape is enforced.

network_domains.description: Optional VLAN name => DNS domain override, for VLANs whose UniFi network domain differs from `domain`. A VLAN absent here uses `domain`.

llm_large_serving_host.description: Short hostname of the heavy-tier LLM serving host. Optional: this host is a fixed-address reservation rather than a PVE guest, so it is absent from `containers` and cannot be derived. Published to consumers as constants.serving.host.

llm_large_serving_ip.description: Reserved address of the heavy-tier LLM serving host (bare IPv4, no mask). Optional, and omitted rather than guessed: consumers fail loudly on absence. Published to consumers as constants.serving.ip.

containers.description: LXC desired-state, keyed by name. At least one is required — an empty map is the empty-{} destroy footgun this schema exists to catch. `_`-prefixed keys are inline `_*comment` docs (tofu strips them) and are exempt from the entry shape.

nodes.description: Cluster node identity, keyed by node name. At least one required.

node_services.description: Per-node (DaemonSet-style) service templates, keyed by service name. OpenTofu expands each into one container per node listed in per_node (locals-node-services.tf). `_`-prefixed keys are inline comment docs.

vdi_preserved_vlans.description: VLAN keys (into network_cidrs) whose subnets VDI guests keep reaching over the LAN rather than through a VPN client running inside the guest. Published to the Ansible inventory as vdi_preserved_cidrs. Omit or empty to disable.

node_service_template.description: One per-node service template. Only the shape the generator dereferences unconditionally is required; per_node keys MUST be keys of `nodes` — JSON Schema cannot express that cross-sibling constraint, so it is enforced by the postcondition on data.aws_s3_object.deployment in main.tf.

per_node.description: Node key -> instance allocation. `_`-prefixed keys are inline comment docs.

container_input.description: A single container's desired-state. Only the fields that break addressing/identity if absent are required; everything else is free. node_name is among them: it used to be optional and tofu silently fell back to the primary node, so omitting it was indistinguishable from choosing it.

node_name.description: Proxmox node this container is placed on. Must be a key of `nodes`.

openbao_cluster_input.description: Parameterized OpenBao LXC cluster generator. OpenTofu expands this into regular containers so shared peer config is defined once.

placement.description: Map of Proxmox node name to OpenBao suffixes. Suffix drives name, VMID, and IP host octet.
